$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天同獨坐卯酉，《深造講義》p.116。

basis.quote: 能白手成家的天同，必定精神充实

rules.text: 你的天同化祿，天機化權成為推動力，無論如何都不致精神空虛。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong is transformed by Lu, with Tian Ji transformed by Quan as the driving force, so you won't fall into inner emptiness.

source.quote: 故无论如何亦不致沦为精神空虚

rules.text: 你的天同化權，物質生活容易充足，精神上卻未必充實。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong is transformed by Quan: material life is easily full, but the inner life isn't necessarily so.

source.quote: 否则为物质生活充足，而精神生活空虚之征兆

rules.text: 你的天同與擎羊同宮，又會火鈴或空劫：人生較為艱苦，容易流於精神空虛。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong shares the palace with Qing Yang and also meets Huo Xing, Ling Xing, Di Kong or Di Jie: life is harder, and inner emptiness comes more easily.

rules.text: 你的天同在卯，對面遷移宮有祿存：精神和物質生活都充足豐滿。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong sits in Mao with Lu Cun opposite: both inner and material life are full and rich.

source.quote: 为精神物质生活皆充足丰满之象

rules.text: 你的天同在酉，對面遷移宮有祿存，太陰同時化忌，反而容易精神空虛。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong sits in You with Lu Cun opposite, and Tai Yin then turns to Obstruction, which tends towards inner emptiness instead.

rules.text: 精神充實的你，行到破軍化祿的運，就是發跡的根基。
rules.en: With your inner life full, a phase in which Po Jun is in Abundance lays the foundation of your rise.

rules.text: 精神面較虛的你，行到破軍化權的運，人生會覺得充實，精神物質都如意；只是那段時間不宜隨便與人合作。
rules.en: With your inner life thinner, a phase in which Po Jun is in Authority fills your life, in spirit and in means alike; but in that time, do not team up with others lightly.

source.quote: 人生必感充实，精神物质皆如意

rules.text: 天機化權的那一步運，對你就像機器得了原動力，是最喜歡的運。
rules.en: A phase with Tian Ji in Authority is like an engine getting its drive: it is the phase that suits you best.

rules.text: 廉貞天相所在的那一步運，就算吉星齊會，也不宜自己開創事業，與人合作或協助別人較好。
rules.en: In the phase that runs through Lian Zhen–Tian Xiang, even with helpful stars all round, do not strike out on your own; partnering or supporting others suits you better.
